about: Sentences said by synthesized voices (written to WAV, never played), heard by Iris's Whisper at each engine's default model: how likely Whisper found each language (its three likeliest, and Italian, English and German), from the speech the VAD keeps, as Whisper tells the language when given none. Italian by voices made for other languages (Pocket TTS's voices through its Italian model, Kokoro's through espeak's Italian), and by two made for Italian; English, German, French, Spanish and Portuguese as a user switching to them from Italian, by voices made for them and for others. A clip is <language>-<engine>-<voice>-<short|long><n>, its sentence sentences[language][short|long][n], the language its voice was made for made_for[<engine>-<voice>]. 'heard': what Whisper wrote and the language it wrote in, going by what it heard alone, where it took the clip for another language than the one said.
